kripos_2020.name: Nasjonal drapsoversikt 2020 (national homicide overview), table: homicide cases by police district
kripos_2020.years: ten-year window before the edition year plus the edition year
kripos_2020.notes: Counts of homicide cases (not victims) by police district, extracted from the PDF with pdftotext -layout. A dash (-) in the PDF is recorded as 0; each row was checked against the published Sum/Totalt column. Editions revise earlier years, so the same year can differ between editions; each edition kept under its own source_key.
